title: Pure Black Dinosaur
summary: Black Dinosaur represents Rex Raptor and Tyranno Hassleberry's classic 'Black' Dinosaur series (Black Tyranno, Black Brachios, Black Ptera, Black Stego, and Black Veloci), modernized by Souleating Oviraptor and Double Evolution Pill. By sending Black Ptera to the GY or banishing it via Pill, the deck swarms the board with high-ATK Tyrannos that pierce and attack directly.

allow.Souleating Oviraptor: Core Dinosaur starter that searches or dumps any Black Dinosaur and destroys Black Ptera on field to revive another Dinosaur.
allow.Miscellaneousaurus: Protects all Dinosaurs on the field from activated effects and banishes Dinosaurs from GY to summon a Dinosaur from Deck.
allow.Babycerasaurus: Signature Dinosaur that summons a Level 4 or lower Black Dinosaur from the Deck when destroyed by card effect.
allow.Double Evolution Pill: Banishes a Dinosaur and a non-Dinosaur to summon Black Tyranno or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno from Deck.
allow.Animadorned Archosaur: Level 1 Dinosaur that pops Babycerasaurus or Black Ptera in hand to search Double Evolution Pill.
allow.Fossil Dig: Searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur monster from the Deck.
allow.Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Black Dinosaurs that negates Summons and Spell/Traps.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Black Dinosaurs that negates monster effects twice per turn.

main: Black Tyranno
Classic Level 7 boss that can attack the opponent directly if the only cards they control are Defense Position monsters.
Ultimate Conductor Tyranno
Modern Tyranno evolution that flips all opposing monsters face-down and attacks every monster they control.
Super Conductor Tyranno
Classic Level 8 Tyranno boss with 3300 ATK that tributes a monster to burn for 1000 damage.
Black Brachios
Changes a monster on the field to Defense Position on Normal Summon, setting up Black Tyranno's direct attack condition.
Black Veloci
Gains 400 ATK when attacking and loses 400 ATK when attacked, serving as a 2200 ATK Level 4 attacker.
Black Ptera
Returns to the hand whenever it is sent from the field to the GY, except by battle.
Black Stego
Automatically switches to Defense Position (2000 DEF) when targeted for an attack.
Souleating Oviraptor
Searches or dumps any Dinosaur on Summon and destroys Black Ptera or Babycerasaurus to revive a Dinosaur.
Miscellaneousaurus
Discards itself to make Dinosaurs unaffected by opponent's activated effects and summons Archosaur from the Deck.
Animadorned Archosaur
Destroys a Dinosaur in hand or field to search Double Evolution Pill.
Babycerasaurus
Summons Black Brachios, Black Veloci, or Oviraptor from the Deck when destroyed by Oviraptor or Archosaur.
Fossil Dig
Searches Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, or any Level 4 Black Dinosaur.
Double Evolution Pill
Summons Black Tyranno, Super Conductor Tyranno, or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from the Deck.
extra: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Dinosaurs for omni-negation.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Dinosaurs to negate two monster effects.
